title: Compatibility Gatekeeper: automated runtime compat checks & staged deprecation windows
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and implement a Compatibility Gatekeeper service and playbook that automatically validates runtime API changes against a compatibility matrix, enforces staged deprecation windows, and wires migration telemetry into rollout gates. The goal is to minimize user breakage across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments by moving compatibility checks earlier in CI/CD and making safe rollouts the default for schema or behavioral changes.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility Gatekeeper runs as a CI check that evaluates PRs touching runtime APIs and surface-level behavior changes
Gatekeeper produces a machine-readable compatibility report (pass/warn/fail) and attaches it to the PR
Defined deprecation window policy enforced: minor-level deprecations require >=90-day window with automated warning headers and dashboard signals
Rollout pipeline integrates Gatekeeper signals and can auto-block canary-to-global promotion on fail/warn thresholds
Migration telemetry (consumer client versions, adapter usage, error deltas) is surfaced in Console and used by release automation to set rollback triggers
Documentation and playbook published in Confluence and linked from PR templates and release checklist
implementation_notes: Leverage existing compatibility tooling (compat-score) to generate diff-based compatibility matrices for proto/JSON schemas
Add a lightweight Gatekeeper microservice that accepts PR artifact refs and returns compatibility verdict + remediation hints
Extend amcli (internal deploy tool) to query Gatekeeper before promoting canaries; expose override with justification
Create an automated header injection for deprecation headers in hosted responses and a policy for tokens to flag SDK clients
Instrument runtime to emit consumer-version telemetry with privacy-preserving hashes; push to Console metrics with retention 90d for migration windows
Create a migration health dashboard that correlates new code rollout, client versions, error rates, and per-route latency

decision_log: 2025-02-15 Decided: Use three-tier verdicts (pass/warn/fail) to avoid blocking low-risk changes and to provide staged remediation
2025-02-16 Decided: 'warn' must include an automated migration path or a compatibility shim suggestion if available

2025-02-18 Decided: Deprecated fields will be maintained for the configured deprecation window (default 90 days) and served with deprecation headers for Hosted only; Dedicated/Private will receive advisory notices unless contract opts-in
